newsitem.title: INDIA: India Castrol soars 2 pct to record high.
newsitem.headline: India Castrol soars 2 pct to record high.

text.p: Shares of Castrol India Ltd jumped to an all-time high of 692.0 rupees in Thursday afternoon trade led by strong foreign fund buying, dealers said.
By 1320 hours (0750 GMT), the stock had gained 12.0 rupees, or 1.76 percent, surpassing its recent record of 685.0, they said.

Castrol has consistently outperformed the market, surging 62 percent in the last two months on expectations that the company might consider an issue of bonus shares at a board meeting set for August 5.
Castrol is due to announce first half results for the period ending June 30, 1997 at the meeting. Company officials refused to comment on the bonus rumours.
